svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.4.1 Mezzanines not Considered as Storeys
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.4.1 Mezzanines not Considered as Storeys
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Mezzanines not Considered as Storeys

g.text: Mezzanine: 10% or less of the floor area
of the building, and 10% or less of the
area of the suite on that storey
Mezzanines 40% or less of the open area
of the room, the space above them open,
Enclosed space above the mezzanine: 10% or
less of the open area of the room, not
obstructing the view to the room below
maintenance only: not a floor or mezzanine
for building height if it is not used for

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
The space above a mezzanine is permitted to be excluded from the
calculation of building height, provided
(a) the aggregate area of mezzanines that are not superimposed does not
exceed 10% of the floor area of the building in which they are located, and
(b) the area of mezzanine in a suite does not exceed 10% of the area of that
suite on the storey on which it is located. Except as required by Sentences
The space above a mezzanine is permitted to be excluded from the
calculation of building height, provided
(a) the aggregate area of mezzanines that are not superimposed does not
exceed 40% of the open area of the room in which they are located (see Note
A-3.2.1.1.(3)(a)), and (b) except as permitted in Sentence (3), the space
above the mezzanine floor is used as an open area without partitions or
subdividing walls higher than 1 070 mm (3′-6⅛″) above the mezzanine floor.
Except as required by Sentence 9.10.4.2.(1).
The space above a mezzanine conforming to Sentence (2) is permitted to
include an enclosed space whose area does not exceed 10% of the open
area of the room in which the mezzanine is located
Provided the enclosed space does not obstruct visual communication between
the open space above the mezzanine and the room in which it is located.
For determining occupant load, the areas of mezzanines not considered
as storeys are added to the floor area of the storey on which they are
located
Note A-9.10.4.1.(4): mezzanines increase the occupant load and the fire load
of the storey of which they are part.
Platforms and catwalks intended solely for periodic inspection and
maintenance need not be considered as floor assemblies or mezzanines
for calculating building height, provided
(a) they are not used for storage, and (b) they are constructed with
noncombustible materials, unless the building is permitted to be of
combustible construction.
Enclosed space below a mezzanine is deducted from the open area of the room
before the percentage is applied.
Drawn: one room in 10 equal bays (dashed lines), so one bay is 10% of its area. Walls cut low.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.4.1. (page 9-62)
